title: 旅遊日文 EP1：拉麵店點餐（JV Tutor Corner）

xinyi.appearance: shoulder-length wavy dark chestnut brown hair, almond eyes, heart-shaped face, slim build
xinyi.style: beige trench coat over a navy striped top, small crossbody bag

junho.style: black t-shirt under a dark indigo apron, black bandana tied on his head

shots.label: 旅遊日文 EP1
shots.phrase: 去日本只會說「すみません」？
shots.translation: 3 句日文，拉麵店點餐不用比手畫腳

shots.prompt: stepping into a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, looking around curiously
shots.motion: she slides the door open, steps in and looks around the ramen shop

shots.prompt: behind the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, energetic welcoming smile
shots.motion: he looks up and greets the customer cheerfully

shots.prompt: sitting at the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, curious and slightly unsure
shots.motion: she leans forward and asks politely
shots.line: すみません、おすすめは何ですか？
shots.translation: 不好意思，推薦的是什麼？

shots.label: 今日句型 1
shots.note: Osusume wa nan desu ka?｜不知道點什麼時最好用

shots.prompt: behind the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, friendly, gesturing with an open hand
shots.motion: he gestures with an open hand and recommends
shots.line: 醤油ラーメンがおすすめです。

shots.prompt: sitting at the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, decided, happy smile
shots.motion: she nods and orders with a smile
shots.line: じゃあ、醤油ラーメンをひとつください。
shots.translation: 那請給我一碗醬油拉麵。

shots.label: 今日句型 2
shots.line: 醤油ラーメンをひとつください。

shots.prompt: behind the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, bowing slightly
sitting at the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, a steaming bowl of ramen in front of her, delighted
shots.motion: she puts her hands together in front of the steaming bowl and smiles

shots.prompt: standing by the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, holding a small wallet, polite smile
shots.motion: she holds her wallet and asks politely
shots.line: すみません、お会計お願いします。

shots.prompt: behind the wooden counter of a small cozy Japanese ramen shop, wooden counter, warm lights, steam rising, bowing with a big smile
shots.motion: he bows with a big smile
shots.line: ありがとうございました！

shots.label: JV Tutor Corner
shots.phrase: 旅遊日文：跟團自助都好用
shots.translation: 交通、購物、用餐、問路，從零開始
